scholarship_title: InterMaths Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Interdisciplinary Mathematics, 2026 intake
provider_organization: InterMaths consortium led by the University of L'Aquila, funded by the European Union (Erasmus Mundus)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Full exemption from the EUR 18,000 two-year participation costs

stipend.notes: EMJM scholarship allowance for the two-year programme; scholars pay their own living costs from it

additional_benefits: University of L'Aquila travel and installation contribution of about EUR 3,000 (not confirmed for 2026)

application_fee.notes: The consortium says it charges no application fee.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Bachelor's (or 180 ECTS equivalent) in mathematics, applied mathematics, physics, engineering or similar with a very strong maths background
language_proficiency: English B2: IELTS Academic 6.0, TOEFL iBT 80, PTE Academic 56 or C1 Advanced 169 (no more than four years old)
No certificate needed if your degree was taught in English (proof required)

required_documents.name: English certificate or proof of English-taught degree
Two academic reference letters
required_documents.detail: Sent by referees through the online tool; referee deadline two weeks after the application deadline

preparation_alerts: Book an English test early or get a letter showing your degree was taught in English
Ask two academic referees early; they submit online after your application

source_urls.title: InterMaths: how to apply (2026 edition)
source_urls.used_for: Deadlines, scholarship amounts, eligibility, English, documents, 20 scholarships, no fee

verification_status.verification_notes: The official page still shows the 2026 edition (scholarship deadline 25 Feb 2026 13:00 CET, referees 11 Mar, results 30 Apr). The 2027 call was not published at last_verified. 20 EMJM scholarships, 3 reserved for targeted regions (which regions not stated). Selection criteria and mobility path between partners not read. The 2022 tweet also mentioned MathMods and RealMaths on one form; not checked.
